payload.rationale: Planning-stage reader (brief). The brief's goal is Wonderland Studio, which the copy links early where the plan-first point is made, so the reader meets the tool at the moment the table-plan question is raised. Concierge is the commercial follow-on for couples marrying overseas, offered three times without pressure; the panel's cta_reactions were 'maybe' (planner_couple, funding_parent) and 'no' (sceptic, search_visitor, uhnw), with every persona calling it polite and not pushy. The 'maybe' readers wanted to see things first that are deferred or not in brand-facts.md (who is on the ground on the day, venue liaison, real weddings, fee model, deposits and AUD quotes), so no copy change is proposed here; those stay with the orchestrator and Nic. All targets (/wonderland-concierge, /wonderland-studio, /magazine) exist in link-map.csv. Concierge and magazine UTMs follow the services.md format with utm_campaign=our-favourite-interactive-seating-charts. Suggested lead magnet, not placed: a downloadable booking checklist for seating display planning and the venue questions; it has no page, so exists is false. A page for it would suit this planning-stage reader better than the magazine.
